description: Secure-by-default firewall for Windows built on Windows Firewall. Developer: Károly Pados.

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "TinyWall MSI not found: $msi" }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "TinyWall MSI installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "TinyWall MSI not found: $msi. Refusing to remove Scoop files while Windows Installer registration may remain." }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "TinyWall MSI uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

notes: Uses TinyWall's official per-machine MSI installation, including its ProgramData files, LocalSystem automatic service, and TinyWall Controller logon task.
Scoop retains the MSI in the version directory so Windows Installer can run the native uninstall action during removal and updates. Uninstallation requires administrator approval.
TinyWall blocks most communication by default. Use the tray menu's whitelist options to allow required applications; do not install or first-run it over a remote connection.
